spec.description: Kingspan AIR-CELL Insuliner® is a reflective insulation product suitable for use in metal framed walls on low-rise structures, with a Group 2 fire performance classification according to NCC fire ratings.
features: Reflective insulation with a fibre-free core
Sandwiched with an anti-glare foil facing and a plain foil facing
spec.fire: Group 2 classification to NCC fire ratings for wall and ceiling linings
install: Lay Kingspan AIR-CELL perpendicular to purlins ensuring a max. 25 mm overlap into the gutter.
Allow a nominal 40 mm sag between purlins.
Overlap by 50 mm at joins and apply minimum 72 mm wide Kingspan reinforced aluminium insulation tape to top of join.
End joins should be overlapped by 600 mm if not taped.
Fix roof sheeting by screwing through Kingspan AIR-CELL to the purlins.
Attach end of insulation roll to end fixing point using three 12 gauge Tek screws.
Join subsequent alongside rolls by butt joining and tape joint with minimum 72 mm wide Kingspan reinforced aluminium insulation tape.
Fix a steel furring channel, top hat or similar over Kingspan AIR-CELL to the bottom of the purlins.
Ensure a 100 mm clearance between insulation and heat producing items.
If required to act as a water vapour barrier, tape the joints.
clearances: 100 mm clearance between insulation and heat producing items such as hot flues, light fittings and transformers.
limitations: Suitable for use in metal framed walls on low-rise structures.
For consideration in high-rise buildings, contact Kingspan Insulation’s Technical Services team.
